rules: Every agent must return JSON with status, message, data fields
Maximum 6 steps per plan, last step must be verification
Use run_codex_exec for LLM calls, never call codex CLI directly
Mobile-first design — test at 375px width
No breaking API changes to /api/* endpoints
All API responses must include proper JSON content-type
No new global variables without documenting them at file top
Every new function needs error handling with log_msg
Maintain backward compatibility with existing function signatures
Queue operations must be atomic — use temp file + rename
Always respect TASK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
Hot reload must debounce to prevent data loss
Never overwrite tasks.json entirely — use atomic updates
Memory files must not exceed reasonable sizes (index.md max 200 lines)
Always append, never truncate decision/context logs
On review_rejection, include a structured diff hint in the rejection message for the retry
Reviewer must output a classification field (pass, fail, indeterminate) — never omit it
Evaluator must capture failure_kind for every non-SUCCESS result
Reject self-improve tasks whose title exceeds 220 characters
Cap planning phase to 60s before first step execution
Maximum 6 steps per plan, last step must be verification
